Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Wikipedia page that WebSurfer had just opened, which clearly stated “Children: 3, including Kim Braden” and in the body “A third child, Kim, was born in London in 1949.” The Planner incorrectly framed this as an inconsistency and proceeded to favor a “two children” narrative, dismissing Kim Braden despite authoritative evidence. This misreading and persistence led directly to the wrong solution.
